title: pseudo-fumaria alba subsp. leiosperma
intro: Pseudo-fumaria alba subsp. leiosperma, commonly known as White Fumitory, is a plant species belonging to the Fumariaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, and its health benefits include treating respiratory issues, digestive problems, and skin conditions due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of White Fumitory include acting as an antitussive, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory agent. Its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
